newsitem.title: ITALY: Brazil's Cardoso begins Italy visit.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Cardoso begins Italy visit.

text.p: President Fernando Henrique Cardoso of Brazil met President Oscar Luigi Scalfaro on Tuesday at the start of a five-day visit to Italy and the Vatican.
Cardoso told reporters at his arrival on Monday night that his visit was primarily "to reinforce our already good cultural and economic ties".
He was due to visit parliament later on Tuesday and will meet Prime Minister Romano Prodi on Wednesday.
Pope John Paul is due to receive the Brazilian president on Friday at the Vatican.
